TokenMeter v0.2.5 restores Codex quota refresh after desktop app updates and refreshes the multi-provider price catalog.

- Discover the new nested Codex CLI app, legacy desktop layouts, and standalone CLI installations on every refresh, including launchd's minimal PATH.
- Prefer the official main quota bucket; on a failed refresh, allow a newer validated local main-bucket snapshot to replace stale cache. Keep 5H/7D windows together and hide quotas for signed-out/API-only/free accounts without opening a login flow.
- Add Claude Sonnet 5.5, Gemini 3.7/3.8 Flash, Qwen3.8 and GLM-5.3 family mappings; recheck GPT-6 and Opus 5.5. Apply Gemini promotion expiry and DeepSeek peak/off-peak rates using request timestamps while retaining prior price segments.

See the [pricing audit](../../docs/pricing-2026-09-29.md) for exact rates, sources, regional/cache assumptions and historical boundaries. Costs are API-equivalent estimates, not subscription charges.

Requires macOS 13 or later; the universal archive supports Apple Silicon and Intel. Existing preferences, source logs and account login state are preserved.
